outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic-style diagram illustrating exposure/overhead time bars and associated percentages, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Scatter/line plot showing mean ΔROS per condition with error bars and a fitted trend line; scatter plots are exempt.
Line plots showing individual cell migration tracks; these already represent individual data (each line = one cell), and line plots are exempt from overlay requirement.
Bar chart of mean migration speed per condition with individual cell data points overlaid as dots.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (Mitotracker, Paxillin, Merge), not a quantitative plot.
Panel G is a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a plot.
Panel H is a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a plot.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
